title: TDS meter solids nahi ginta, sirf current naapta hai! 💧 #shorts
description:
RO ka paani saaf dikhta hai, par kitna saaf hai?
TDS meter solids nahi ginta, sirf conductivity naapta hai.
🔬 Do metal needles paani ka conductivity naapti hain
📈 Zyada namak, zyada conductivity, zyada voltage
🌡️ Temperature se reading badalti hai, 25 °C default
⚠️ Low TDS ka matlab safe paani nahi hota
